title: Brazil's OGX, conglomerate headed by Eike Batista, files for bankruptcy
主要内容: Brazil's OGX, a conglomerate led by Eike Batista, filed for bankruptcy protection in a landmark move for Latin America. The company, which is part of the EBX Group Co. Ltd., sought court protection from creditors after failing to reach an agreement on renegotiating its $5.1 billion debt. The bankruptcy filing, confirmed by the court in Rio de Janeiro, marks a significant chapter in the decline of Batista's once-thriving industrial empire. If approved, OGX will have 60 days to present a restructuring plan, with creditors having 30 days to endorse or reject it. The company's creditors include Pimco and BlackRock. While the bankruptcy is unlikely to significantly impact Brazil's economy, it highlights the broader economic challenges facing the country. OGX's decision to seek bankruptcy protection came after missing an interest payment, leading to a debt restructuring crisis. The company's market value has plummeted by nearly $45 billion since its peak in 2010, reflecting the broader economic downturn in Brazil.
